# Route

The routes of the host.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/network/route`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node network route` |
| Jobs | `behavior.route.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Where it runs

On `debian`, `linux`, `darwin`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

`create` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

`update` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

`delete` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

On linux it also runs `ip`.

On darwin it also runs `ifconfig`, `netstat`.

It runs `ethtool` when the host has it, and reads without it otherwise.

It writes `/etc/netplan/osapi-*-routes.yaml`.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.route.<method>`, with `behavior.netplan.<method>`, `behavior.managedfile.<method>`, `exec ip`, `exec ifconfig`, `exec netstat`, `exec ethtool`, `exec netplan`, `exec chown`, `exec stat`, `file.write`, `file.remove`, `file.chmod`, `kv.get`, `kv.put` under it.

Its span records the input `interface_name` (get, create, update, delete).

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Permission | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| [`list`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/route/list.md) | read | `network:read` | List the routes of the host |
| [`get`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/route/get.md) | read | `network:read` | Get the routes of an interface |
| [`create`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/route/create.md) | write | `network:write` | Add static routes to an interface |
| [`update`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/route/update.md) | write | `network:write` | Change the routes osapi has of an interface |
| [`delete`](../../usage/cli/client/node/network/route/delete.md) | write | `network:write` | Drop the routes osapi has of an interface |
